description: Codebase Quality Improvements - Data integrity fixes, test coverage for critical paths, and code organization cleanup

userStories.title: Add Transaction Wrapper Utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable transaction wrapper so that multi-step operations are atomic.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper accepts callback with Prisma transaction client parameter
Proper error handling and automatic rollback on failure
Export the helper function for use across services
userStories.notes: Blocker for US-002, US-003, US-004. Use Prisma's $transaction callback pattern.

userStories.title: Fix Default Profile Race Condition
userStories.description: As a user, I need default profile operations to be atomic so I don't lose my default when concurrent requests occur.
acceptanceCriteria: Import withTransaction from lib/db/transaction.ts in profiles.service.ts
Wrap unsetAllDefaults() + update() in setDefaultProfile() in a transaction
Wrap profile creation with isDefault: true in a transaction
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001. Find setDefaultProfile and create methods in profiles.service.ts.

userStories.title: Add Transactions to Profile Deletion
userStories.description: As a user, I need profile deletion to be atomic so that default reassignment doesn't fail partially.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap delete + reassign-default logic in profiles.service.ts in a transaction
Count check, delete, and reassign must be atomic within single transaction
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001. Look for delete method in profiles.service.ts.

userStories.title: Add Transactions to AI Settings Operations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need AI settings multi-model updates to be transactional.
acceptanceCriteria: Review ai-settings.repository.ts for multi-step operations beyond line 172
Wrap any compound operations in transactions using withTransaction helper
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001. One transaction already exists at line 172.

userStories.title: Implement Distributed Locking for Cache
userStories.description: As a system, I need distributed locking so concurrent requests don't read stale cache data.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement acquireLock(key: string, ttlMs: number) function using Redis SET NX EX
Add fallback behavior when lock acquisition fails (proceed without lock after timeout)
userStories.notes: Independent of transaction stories. Check existing Redis setup in lib/cache/.

userStories.title: Add Cache Lock to Profile Operations
userStories.description: As a user, I need profile cache operations to be consistent under concurrent access.
acceptanceCriteria: Import distributed lock functions in profile cache invalidation code
Wrap profile cache invalidation with distributed lock
Use lock key based on userId pattern: `profile-cache-lock:${userId}`
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005. Find where profile cache invalidation happens.
